summary: Blends 3-channel pixel data by summing three lookup-table reads into a single output byte per source pixel. Reads a context pointer from this+0x1A4, from which an array of three table base pointers is loaded at +0x18. For each pixel descriptor in the a3 array (a4 total), reads a source byte pointer and destination byte pointer, then for each of this+0x5C bytes accumulates LUT0[src0] + LUT1[src1] + LUT2[src2] into the destination. Outer loop is skipped when a4 <= 0; the inner blend loop is skipped when this+0x5C is zero.

local_names.a1: context object whose +0x1A4 points at the LUT container
local_names.a2: source buffer base used to derive each pixel's source pointer
local_names.a3: pixel descriptor array; each entry holds a destination pointer (*entry) and a source pointer
local_names.a4: pixel count driving the outer loop
local_names.v7: per-pixel byte count read from this+0x5C; inner loop bound
local_names.v15: saved stride used to reload v7 each outer iteration

operations.description: Read context pointer from this+0x1A4, then load the lookup-table array base from that context at +0x18
Load the three table base pointers into v18, v17, v16 from the table array indices 0, 4, 8
Load the per-pixel byte count (stride) from this+0x5C into v7; this value is the inner loop bound and is saved/restored around each pixel
Outer processing is skipped entirely when the pixel count a4 is not greater than 0
Iterate over a4 pixel descriptors in the a3 array; each descriptor contributes a destination pointer (*v8) and a source pointer computed from a2
Per-pixel inner blend only runs when the saved stride v7 is non-zero; a zero stride skips the lookup-sum for that pixel
Inner loop walks v7 source bytes; each iteration reads one byte through each of the three tables and advances the source pointer by three bytes
Output byte = LUT0[src byte 0] + LUT1[src byte 1] + LUT2[src byte 2], accumulated as a character sum
Store the summed byte into the destination pointer and advance it
Return the leftover pointer-difference value (a2 - a3); not a meaningful checksum result
